purpose: Teach: マタイ/カンジ/エッセンス/面々/国崎/土屋/大森/樋口

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、新約聖書のマタイ伝の文献研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura, you covered Matthew's Gospel — the New Testament literature — in your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Steady, warm confirmation. Encouraging tone. Slight pause before the clarification, as if inviting her to expand. Even pacing, genuinely interested.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、日本語のカンジ、つまり漢字の歴史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I wrote about the history of kanji, Japanese characters, in my research.
lines.style: Direct, clear response. Small lift at the start showing she's tracking. Respectful but not stiff. Confident without overstatement.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 和食のエッセンス、つまり日本料理の本質研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And the essence of washoku — the fundamental principles of Japanese cuisine — that was your focus as well?
lines.style: Gentle, reflective tone. Thoughtful pacing. Sounds like she's making a connection, almost to herself. Warm recognition of the breadth of work.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、研究者面々のご意見をまとめた論文を執筆しました
lines.en: Yes, I compiled the perspectives and opinions of various researchers into my thesis.
lines.style: Clear, direct delivery. Measured pace. Slight emphasis on the synthesis she did — not defensive, just clarifying her contribution. Composed.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 宇佐神宮の国崎、つまり国東半島の地理研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you also researched the geography of Kunisaki — the peninsula near Usa Shrine — in another paper?
lines.style: Warm, steady tone. Sounds genuinely impressed by the range. Gentle pacing, no pressure. The affirmation of a teacher who sees the student's effort.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、考古学者土屋先生の発掘成果を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I focused on the archaeological findings and discoveries of Professor Tsuchiya.
lines.style: Confident, clear. Even tempo. She's settling into the rhythm now — direct acknowledgment of what she did. Respectful to her source.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 貝類研究家大森博士のご研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you examined the research of Dr. Omori, the shellfish and mollusc specialist, in another work?
lines.style: Thoughtful, wondering tone. Slightly softer — acknowledging the range of fields. Gentle curiosity, as if building a picture of her breadth.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、言語学者樋口先生の方言研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote about the dialect research of Professor Higuchi, the linguist.
lines.style: Calm, final note of completion. Small sense of closure. Clear and centered. Proud but understated.
